name: Drift Vaults

requiredConfig.name: RPC connection
requiredConfig.description: Mainnet RPC the bridge or browser planner uses to query Drift vault state. Cluster mismatches must be rejected with safety.action_not_exposed.

requiredConfig.name: Drift SDK wiring
requiredConfig.description: @drift-labs/sdk and @drift-labs/vaults-sdk must be installed by the host and a Drift vault client factory must be registered via setDriftVaultClientFactory(). Without the factory, reads and prepares return an explicit unavailable error.

readCapabilities.returns: Drift user account snapshot for a wallet and optional subaccount: deposits, borrows, total/free collateral, margin ratio.
Drift strategy vault snapshot: name, manager, deposit mint, decimals, share price, redeem period, lockup, profit share, management fee, pending withdraw shares.
Wallet depositor positions across Drift strategy vaults, including shares, value at share price, and pending withdraw shares. Optional vaultAddress filter.
Drift vault withdraw status for a wallet and vault: hasPendingRequest, requested shares, redeemableAt, isReady, redeemPeriodSec.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that captures vault, manager, deposit mint, amount, share price, redeem period, lockup, profit share, management fee, and depositor state. No transaction is signed at prepare time.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Drift vault deposit transaction built at execute time, with refreshed vault snapshot. Depositor account creation is part of the same approval when explicitly opted in via initializeDepositorIfMissing.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction for a Drift vault withdraw request, scoped to a single vault and a single unit (token or shares). Captures vault facts, redeemableAt, depositor position, and refreshAtExecution: true.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Drift vault request-withdraw transaction built at execute time. The vault redeem period determines when complete-withdraw becomes available.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that cancels a pending Drift vault withdraw request. Rejected if no pending request exists.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Drift vault cancel-withdraw transaction built at execute time. Vault state is re-checked before signing.

writeCapabilities.prepares: An inbox-bound PreparedAction that completes a pending Drift vault withdraw after the redeem period elapses. Rejected if the redeem period has not elapsed or there is no pending request.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: A Drift vault complete-withdraw transaction built at execute time. Readiness is re-verified before signing.

requiredUserInputs.name: vaultAddress
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Which Drift vault should I use?

requiredUserInputs.name: amount
requiredUserInputs.prompt: How much (in vault deposit token units)?

requiredUserInputs.name: shares
requiredUserInputs.prompt: How many vault shares should I withdraw (when withdrawUnit is 'shares')?

requiredUserInputs.name: withdrawUnit
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Withdraw by token amount or by share amount?

requiredUserInputs.name: initializeDepositorIfMissing
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Create the vault depositor account in this approval if it is missing?

requiredUserInputs.name: dueAt
requiredUserInputs.prompt: Should this action wait until a specific time before becoming ready? (ISO 8601, optional)

requiredConnectorFacts: Vault address, name, manager, and deposit mint
Vault redeem period and lockup seconds
Vault profit share and management fee basis points
Wallet depositor shares and value at share price
Wallet pending withdraw shares and redeemableAt
unsupportedRequests: Place a Drift perp order or close a perp position. V1 does not expose perp trading.
Spot margin trading, borrows, or leveraged positions on Drift.
Open or close leverage / Swift orders.
Batch request-withdraw and complete-withdraw into one prepared action.
Complete a vault withdraw before the redeem period has elapsed.
Initialize a vault depositor account without explicit initializeDepositorIfMissing opt-in.
Operate on any cluster other than mainnet-beta.
actionPreparationNotes: Resolve vaultAddress to a Drift vault snapshot at prepare time and store name, manager, deposit mint, decimals, share price, redeem period, lockup, profit share, management fee, and pending withdraw shares in params. Compute redeemableAt as preparedAt + redeemPeriodSec for request-withdraw. The execute path re-reads the vault snapshot, depositor state, and withdraw status, and refuses if the connected wallet, mint, decimals, or readiness drifted from prepare time.
riskNotes: Drift strategy vaults are manager-controlled. Vault value can move while a withdraw request is queued and the redeem period elapses. Profit share, management fee, and lockup apply on top of share price. Surface these in the review card before approval.
walletApprovalBoundary: Reads return facts without wallet involvement. Vault deposits and the withdraw lifecycle build transactions at execute time that the wallet must sign and broadcast. The agent never signs and never opens or settles a perp position.

requests.agentResponse: Read your Drift vault positions and per-vault shares plus value. The connector reads facts; the wallet still controls approval.

requests.user: check this Drift vault and explain fees and withdraw timing
requests.agentResponse: Read the Drift vault snapshot and reported manager, share price, redeem period, lockup, profit share, and management fee.
Prepared a Drift vault USDC deposit of 25 with the current share price and redeem period. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: request a Drift vault withdraw for 50% of my shares
needsInputQuestions: Should I read your current share balance so '50%' resolves to a concrete share amount?
requests.agentResponse: The agent is missing facts needed to decide. I can read your position with solana_drift_wallet_vault_positions and then prepare a request-withdraw with the exact share count.

requests.user: complete my Drift vault withdrawal if it is ready
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Drift vault complete-withdraw if the redeem period has elapsed. The wallet still controls approval.

requests.user: cancel my pending Drift vault withdraw
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Drift vault cancel-withdraw against the pending request. The wallet still controls approval.

The agent denied this because vault returns are manager-controlled and cannot be guaranteed.

requests.user: complete my Drift vault withdraw before the redeem period elapses
requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because Drift's redeem period has not elapsed. Wait until the vault marks the request ready and re-prepare.

requests.user: deposit into Drift vault and create the depositor
needsInputQuestions: Should I create the vault depositor account in this approval? (sets initializeDepositorIfMissing: true)
requests.agentResponse: The agent is missing facts needed to decide. Depositor creation is an explicit opt-in inside the same approval.

requests.agentResponse: The agent denied this because this connector is not enabled. Enable Drift Vaults in Protocol Connectors before continuing.
